basic_info.description: Located on the best street in Diamond Heights, directly across from the 67 acre Glenn Canyon, you will find a big, bright midcentury home that will wow you!   This semi-detached, two story over garage, single family home has an open floorpan and views across to the canyon.   You enter into a foyer which leads to a spacious living room with fireplace and formal dining room with glass sliding doors that open to the private deck. Walking through the updated kitchen you will find a massive space that includes a family room, breakfast room and additional lounge space, also with access to the private deck. A half bath completes this floor.  The upper level features four large bedrooms, including a huge primary suite with abundant closet space. The other three bedrooms share an additional full bath.   Back down the impressive stairway we may exit through the garage level which accommodates two car parking, laundry area and plenty of storage.   A central location allows easy access to hiking trails, playgrounds,Diamond Heights Shopping Centers, restaurants, highways and public transportation.  You really don't want to miss this show stopper that checks all the boxes.
